Title: Removal of duplicated attachments Reason for change: In the attachments of TR 38.903 V19.0.0 (2025-09) several archives are duplicated 37.571-1 15.2.1 TT v2.zip and 37.571-1 14.3.7 TT v2.zip Newer versions exist 37.571-1 15.2.1+15.4.1 TT.zip 37.571-1 14.3.7+14.5.4 TT.zip. The issue comes from incomplete implementation of RAN5#105 of two CRs R5-247926 Addition of TT analysis for positioning test case 15.4.1: - the CR had mentioned "Note for the editor: Please replace “37.571-1 15.2.1 TT v2.zip” with “37.571-1 15.2.1+15.4.1 TT.zip” to the attachments of TR 38.903" R5-247896 Addition of TT analysis for positioning test case 14.5.4: the CR had mentioned "Note for the editor: Please replace “37.571-1 14.3.7 TT v2.zip” with “37.571-1 14.3.7+14.5.4 TT.zip” to the attachments of TR 38.903" 

[10] (ran5_tr_sections 38.903 §A, sim=0.3688)
The documents (and spreadsheets where applicable) used to derive the test tolerances for each test case are included in the present document as zip files. The aim is to provide a reference to completed test cases, so that test tolerances for similar test cases can be derived on a common basis. The information on test case grouping in clauses 7 and 8 can be used to identify similarities.
